answer: Divergent Answer Bridge. Each identity must periodically answer a fresh open-ended question whose answer depends on its own accumulated local state, then publish the answer hash. Clones share state and so emit identical answers, which lets anyone link them into one cluster. Honest agents act as a mirror, comparing answer diversity across identities. A lantern test—one randomly chosen identity must explain its answer in a live, state-dependent way—exposes copied responses.
